notes.title: 🔺 Update (v1.1.2) - Attachments 2: Electric Boogaloo (Bug Fixes)
notes.content:
[p]Hello! Today we fixed more attachment related bugs. It's important to note that one of your issues may be non-existent on a fresh Red Light save.[/p][p]For that matter, if you are already close to completing the game, you should complete it on the newest update and a developer console will be unlocked, which you can open with Tilda key. Type refresh_weapons and hit enter; autocomplete works btwːsteamhappyː.[/p][p]In any other case, you can get another gun and it should work fine, or unlock the console manually before completing the game - spoiler alert:[/p][p]
Create new empty text file named h38gnsdl93ng928n.txt in the save folder:
Windows: %APPDATA%\\Redot\\app_userdata\\Red Light\\[/p][p]GNU/Linux: ~/.local/share/Redot/app_userdata/Red\\ Light/[/p][p][/p][p][b]🗒️ Changelog[/b][/p][list][*][p]⭕ Fixed gun attachments issues - can't buy an attachment anymore for a gun you aren't supposed to buy an attachment for[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ Added unlockable dev console when you complete the game[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ Fixed settings not loading correctly[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ Fixed keybindings not saving[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ Fixed 3rd additional slot being not interactable[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ Added an ability to refresh weapons if attachments aren't working (should work in some cases)[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ Fixed fall damage bug and added an unstucking option - press F1 to unstuck (will teleport you slightly forward)[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ Fixed bugs with upgrades giving only 1 of each value - no more 1 HP upgrades, etc.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p] Thank you for playing![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589083/86408fb089357a8c9fe970cb74d297204b324f5e.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Raid an abandoned Soviet R&D Institute in the single-player extraction shooter Red Light
notes.content:
With intense action, Red Light is a single-player extraction shooter not to be missed if you love your retro-styled shooters.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/raid-an-abandoned-soviet-r-d-institute-in-the-single-player-extraction-shooter-red-light/

notes.title: 🔺 Customisation Update (v1.0.6) - Part 1
notes.content: [p]Hello! Today we added crouching and ability to customise your base! This is not everything we wanted to add with Customisation update, but since we already missed 3 days of updates, we decided to roll it out. Stay tuned, as always.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🗒️ Changelog[/b][/p][list][*][p]⭕ Added ability to upgrade your base: buy a toolbox from Mira, use it to enter build mode and buy storage, gun racks and a cool a flag (throw whatever image in saves and call it flag.png)[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ Added crouching (CTRL is default, but it is rebindable)[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ Buffed most of enemies, they were too easy even on the Hardcore mode[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ After unlocking a new map, your Institute waypoint on Hub orients you towards the Bunker entrance[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ As per request, added ADS sensitivity[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ Updated Demo[/p][/*][*][p]⭕ Other small fixes & improvements[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p] Thank you for playing![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589083/86408fb089357a8c9fe970cb74d297204b324f5e.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🔺 Red Light is OUT!
notes.content: [p]Red Light is out on Steam! A challenging and humorous extraction shooter experience promises to make your evening or few better. We worked hard and really hope you like it. Leave your reviews and have fun![/p][p][/p][h1]🐧 Other platforms?[/h1][p]We believe Open Source is the way and Red Light was developed almost fully using FOSS. Soon there is going to be a Linux build, but we haven't tested it yet. So if you use Arch btw, please wait a bit.[/p][p]We aren't sure about MacOS build yet, but it is very possible.[/p][h1]What next?[/h1][p]We tested everything thoroughly, but in the first week or two, some stuff may probably break or you may notice something that we overlooked. For that matter, we will be available (including this weekend) online and will be releasing hotfixes as soon as they are are reported by you.[/p][p]It is really important to us that you leave your feedback and suggest ideas.[/p][p]Red Light is NOT a long term project, but it will have a major customisation update in a few weeks, and after that will be maintained, receiving minor fixes. Soon we be making more cool games for you, so stay tuned! Follow our Discord server for updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589083/86408fb089357a8c9fe970cb74d297204b324f5e.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🔺 Release Delay
notes.content: [p]There was a problem with steam build review, because we made a mistake and Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese are not displayed correctly in the list of languages in Red Light.[/p][h2][b]What does that mean?[/b][/h2][p]The bad news is that even though we can fix this issue right away, another steam review will take another 3-7 days. We are very sorry about that.[/p][p]The GOOD news however, is that we can implement more of your feedback and polish the game more, so if you have something to tell in the feedback section, you are always welcomed to share your opinion![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your understanding.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589083/86408fb089357a8c9fe970cb74d297204b324f5e.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🔺 New Release Date
notes.content:
Hello. Due to demo performance issues, we've decided to postpone the release date by a week to get some time for fixing those problems. Therefore, Red Light will come out on 6th of June. Sorry and thank you for understanding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45589083/86408fb089357a8c9fe970cb74d297204b324f5e.gif[/img]
